question: Should this Feishu pairing failure be owned by ClawHub, or routed to the OpenClaw runtime/Feishu plugin pairing owner?
rationale: Current ClawHub main has only registry, package catalog, CLI auth, and Feishu catalog metadata surfaces; the failing runtime pairing command is outside this checkout, so automation cannot safely choose the owning product boundary.

options.title: Route to runtime or Feishu plugin
options.body: Transfer or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw runtime/Feishu plugin path and collect pairing requester/approver logs there.

options.title: Keep only for a ClawHub API gap
options.body: Keep this in ClawHub only if runtime triage shows pairing depends on a missing registry, package, or install API.

options.title: Request more reporter detail first
options.body: Ask for current OpenClaw version, both sides of the pairing flow, WSL/NAT details, and logs before deciding ownership.

recommendation.title: Route to runtime or Feishu plugin
recommendation.body: Transfer or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw runtime/Feishu plugin path and collect pairing requester/approver logs there.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for ClawHub's CLI/API/catalog boundary and can decide whether this belongs here or in runtime/plugin triage.
